## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, what changes, and why.

## Validation

List relevant tests and manual checks, including skips. For model changes, include exact identities/configuration, independent title separation, category-level misses/false filtering, region coverage and full-pipeline speed.

## Evidence and scope

- State compatibility changes and limitations.
- Identify new dependency/model/media terms and provenance.
- Confirm attachments contain no private media, raw user reports, tokens or personal paths.
- Distinguish automated code tests, reviewed demonstrations and recognition evidence.
